SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT SRNO ,SRNO1 ,RQNO ,PURNO ,PQTY ,PGUBU ,SRNOR ,SRNOR1 ,PURNO1 FROM MRO402 WHERE IFFLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PURNO, SRNO, SRNO1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KDAC' AS BUYER ,'KA' AS SITE ,XPLANT + DIV AS PLANT ,PURNO AS LEGACY_PO_NO ,SRNO + SRNO1 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,'00' AS REVISION ,PGUBU AS STATUS ,ITNO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO ,ITNM AS DESCRIPTION ,SPEC AS SPECIFICATION ,XUNIT AS UNIT_MEASURE ,MAKER AS MAKER_NAME ,PINDT AS ADD_DATE ,PDUDT AS RD_DATE ,PQTY AS ITEM_QTY ,XCOST AS UNIT_PRICE ,PAMT AS ITEM_AMT ,RQNO AS LEGACY_PR_NO ,PURNO1 + SRNOR + SRNOR1 AS REMARK_DETAIL_1 ,XPLANT + DIV AS DELY_TO_LOCATION ,INPTID AS PURCHASER_USER_ID ,DEPT AS REQ_USER_DEPT ,DEPTNM AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME ,EMPNO AS REQ_USER_ID ,EMPNM AS REQ_USER_NAME ,RTRIM(XPLANTNM) + '^' + RTRIM(DIVNM) + '^' + RTRIM(DEPT) + '^' + RTRIM(DEPTNM) + '^' + RTRIM(CLS) + '^' + RTRIM(RDEPT) + '^' AS IV_COLUMN FROM MRO402 WHERE PURNO = '$G_RS.PURNO$' AND SRNO = '$G_RS.SRNO$' AND SRNO1 = '$G_RS.SRNO1$' ORDER BY PURNO, SRNO, SRNO1
UPDATE MRO402 SET IFFLAG = 'Y', ifdate = convert(varchar(10),getdate(),112)+ replace(convert(varchar(8),getdate(),108),':','') WHERE PURNO = '$G_RS.PURNO$' AND SRNO = '$G_RS.SRNO$' AND SRNO1 = '$G_RS.SRNO1$'
